prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable super-chibi-v1 orthographic model sheet. Create ONE white landscape 3:2 sheet containing exactly THREE same-scale, full-body views: FRONT, anatomical LEFT PROFILE (nose points IMAGE LEFT), BACK. True 90-degree profile, back with no face. Same head size and foot baseline. Very large white gutters, every ear/horn/hair/tail/foot entirely inside its own panel, no overlap between figures. Neutral standing with hands relaxed away from body. Clean 2D anime cartoon, tidy slightly bold lines, grouped hair masses, local colour and one cel shadow, no plastic 3D or plush rendering. Text: none except the required Z ornament for GLM.
PROPORTION IS CRITICAL: the second attached image of blue whale maid defines ONLY the radically short TWO-HEAD-TALL body and 2D drawing. Draw the character from image 1 using this tiny-body style. Crown-to-chin HEAD is roughly HALF of crown-to-sole HEIGHT, excluding horns/ears/ahoge. Round wide face and low-set eyes; body below chin no taller than one head; tiny mitten hands, squat torso, extremely short legs and bean shoes. No long thighs/calves, high heels, bust, narrow waist or adult anatomy. Do not copy whale girl's hair/costume/tail to this character. Simplify dense jewellery and embroidery to a few clear identity motifs.
Image 1 is the previously drafted GLM fox maid IDENTITY, but its body is far TOO LONG; compress to the second image's two-head tall form. Long near-black hair fading navy blue at ends, grey-purple eyes, exactly TWO triangular black FOX ears with white inner fur, exactly ONE fluffy black FOX tail with large WHITE tip attached at lower back under apron bow. Black sleep mask with two simple white closed eyelashes worn on FOREHEAD (eyes uncovered), white frilled maid headband. Z black square ornament plus exactly TWO small silver bells on anatomical LEFT, viewer right in front view. Modest black-and-white short maid dress, long white puff sleeves, black bow at collar, white apron, opaque dark tights and extremely tiny round black Mary Jane shoes, no heels. Rear apron bow and tail root visible in back and side. Z is sole readable character; no labels. No eggs, tablet or extra props in model sheet.
